key_impacts: Over 1.3 million people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
21 deaths from the cyclone; subsequent floods caused 23 more deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
Fierce winds and storm surge impacted coastal areas; gusts up to 185 kph recorded at Gopalpur
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh due to torrential rainfall
National highways and key roads were closed; helicopters used for rescue and evacuations
evidence_snippets: On 12 Oct 2013, Phailin crossed the coast south of Brahmapur, Odisha; category 4; mean winds ~120 kt
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods claimed 23 in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh; over 13 lakh evacuated
missing_information: Exact affected district names not listed
Dates for subsequent flooding impacts not specified beyond the 12 Oct 2013 landfall
